independence_instructions: This is an AI-assisted audit and does not satisfy the independent-human annotation requirement.
Use only public task, quality, scenario, metric, overlay, source, and test evidence.
Do not inspect reference branches, solution patches, or model-generated answers.
rationale: Cookiecutter has natural config/prompt, repository-source, generation/hook, and orchestration surfaces. The top-level workflow consumes context, repository cleanup, generation output, replay, and hook-failure contracts, so asynchronous workers can produce mutually inconsistent but textually mergeable implementations. The scoped public evaluator passes on the complete source without bootstrap overlays; the weak initial screening and three Click-sensitive exclusions should remain documented.
